title: CrossGAI: A Cross-Device Generative AI Framework for Collaborative Fashion Design

context_summary: The paper presents CrossGAI, a cross-device generative AI framework for collaborative fashion design. It includes modules for sketch retrieval, generation, and image synthesis, along with computation offloading optimization. The system supports real-time collaboration across devices and integrates AI to enhance design efficiency.
